heading: What’s in an IV Hydration Bag?
alt: An IV hydration bag starts with sterile saline plus electrolytes, B vitamins, vitamin C, glutathione and amino acids

heading: Key Benefits of IV Hydration Therapy
alt: Six IV hydration benefits: rapid rehydration, energy, immune support, recovery, skin, and wellness maintenance

heading: Is IV Hydration Therapy Safe?
alt: IV hydration should be avoided with heart failure, kidney disease or electrolyte disorders, and needs clearance in pregnancy

heading: What to Expect During an IV Hydration Session
alt: An IV hydration session: consultation and vitals, a 30 to 60 minute drip in a recliner, then straight back to your day
